expectations.text: States plainly that the recent-charge lookup is not sufficient
expectations.evidence: "the check you added narrows the failure window, it doesn't close it" and "'Why the new check isn't the fix'"

expectations.text: Identifies the lookup as a check-then-act race rather than a device
expectations.evidence: "TOCTOU race, same as before... The lookup finds nothing, charges again. Redelivery can also happen concurrently (two consumers)"

expectations.text: Recommends a required idempotency key on the charge path
expectations.evidence: "A stable idempotency key per logical charge — derived from the order/invoice ID... Pass it as Stripe's Idempotency-Key header"

expectations.text: Recommends a database unique constraint backing the idempotency key
expectations.evidence: "A unique constraint in your own DB on the order/invoice ID for the charges table"

expectations.text: Separates the defect from the mistake from the underlying system hazard
expectations.evidence: Lists: Defect (340 double-charged), Mistake (redelivered message called charge path), Hazard (charging is not idempotent)

expectations.text: Locates the hazard as a system property rather than as a worker bug or human error
expectations.evidence: "charging is not idempotent — nothing in your system guarantees two charge attempts for the same logical payment can't both succeed"

expectations.text: Sweeps for other non-idempotent side effects reachable from a retry
expectations.evidence: "Anything else consuming from that same queue and doing a non-idempotent side effect on redelivery — sending emails, firing webhooks, writing ledger entries — has the identical exposure"

expectations.text: Treats 'second time this happened' as evidence for pushing to a Control-rung device
expectations.evidence: Acknowledges 'second time' and recommends Control-rung, but does not explicitly connect the recurrence as diagnostic evidence for why Control-rung is needed (vs. Detection-rung)

expectations.text: Attributes cause to the system, not to any person
expectations.evidence: "charging is not idempotent — nothing in your system guarantees" — system design property
